I am an old woman now, sixty-three years, and I have been growing beans on this small piece of land for many seasons. This plot is only a small garden, the beans are mixed with my other crops as I have always done, and I do not waste the little money I have on fertilizer for beans because beans feed the soil themselves — I save what small cash I get for the maize plot. I keep the seeds from last year's harvest like my mother taught me, and I pull the weeds myself with my hoe. The rains come here in Mulanje so I do not carry water, and at my age my daughter helps me sometimes but mostly it is my own two hands.
